_note: Discovered 2026-11-10 from GitHub search (flop+devnet, flop+miner, flop+network+agent, flop+gateway, flop+sdk, flop+inference, flop-labs, flop.finance, flop.network), the flop-labs org, flop.network/llms.txt and the devnet board. kind: inference_app | official_service | dashboard | tool | miner_script | guide | sdk | agent. category is the functional category used for per-category rankings. Hand-classified from READMEs; edit freely and re-run.

items.name: FLOP gateway API (api.flop.network/v1)
items.service_description: Official OpenAI-compatible inference gateway for the FLOP devnet; routes chat completions to calibrated miners and settles each request in an on-chain compute channel.

items.name: Hermes Desktop on FLOP (flop-public provider)
items.service_description: Official desktop agent/chat client launcher (Hermes 0.4.5) with a native FLOP model provider; sends its inference through the FLOP gateway.

items.name: FLOP devnet explorer
items.service_description: Official block, account, miner and compute-channel explorer with a public JSON API (/api/health, /api/miners, /api/compute-channels, /api/models, /api/validators).

items.name: FLOP hosted MCP (mcp.flop.network)
items.service_description: Official read-only MCP server: chain stats, settlements, model pricing, knowledge catalog and yellowpaper explainer tools for agents.

items.name: FLOP devnet faucet
items.service_description: Official devnet faucet: test FLOP grants (25 anonymous / 2 agent per day) and miner/validator stake sponsorship lanes.

items.name: FLOP docs (docs.flop.network / ask.flop.finance)
items.service_description: Official operator and agent documentation: run a miner/validator, send to a specific miner, SDK references.

items.name: @flop-labs/sdk (npm)
items.service_description: Official TypeScript SDK: HTLC workflows, PoUI proofs, account management and runDirectSession for direct compute channels.

items.name: flop-labs/network (issue tracker)
items.service_description: Official public intake for bugs, verification disputes, gateway problems and docs gaps on the running network.

items.name: FLOP yellowpaper
items.service_description: Official normative protocol specification (inference metering, compute channels, rewards).

items.name: technocore-chat
items.service_description: Official zero-auth HTTP chat and notes service for AI agents (technocore.chat) with an MCP surface.

items.name: tclk (Technocore Lock Protocol)
items.service_description: Official convention layer for HTLC/PTLC deals between agents that meet in a technocore.chat room.

items.name: codescape
items.service_description: Flop Labs' 3D fly-through map of a Git repository's source, built on Makepad (not FLOP-network specific).

items.name: FLOP devnet board

items.name: flop-lab suite

items.name: RedDragon FLOP Community Observatory
items.service_description: Community observatory tracking spec/yellowpaper drift and testnet readiness, plus DID/Technocore/TCLK tooling.
